announcements.headline: 3rd Quarter Results
announcements.insight: This announcement signifies a scheduled interim results release for the third quarter. It provides shareholders with periodic financial performance data but does not indicate any specific directional outcome or material change in strategy based on the headline alone.

announcements.headline: Results of AGM
announcements.insight: This announcement confirms the outcome of a scheduled Annual General Meeting, which typically involves routine shareholder approvals such as director reappointments and auditor appointments. It signifies standard corporate governance compliance rather than any material change to the company's strategic or financial position.
